A <c:ffff00>support type<c> <c:ffff00>skill<c>: the ability to handle <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> that
repair <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c>. Covers <c:ffff00>actions<c> that <c:ffff00>{{recover}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{restore}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{revive}}<c>.

A higher <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c> means faster <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>, higher <c:ffff00>defense power<c> and <c:ffff00>evasion<c>
<c:ffff00>power<c>, and more <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> recovered.
On Heal {{part|pl}}, <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> rises when the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c>
fills.
